# Residual analysis - RandomForest (auto-generated by src/residual_analysis.py)

Validation 2017-07-01 -> 2017-07-30, **53,460 rows**. Residual = actual - predicted (positive = the model predicted too little). The test slice is not used.
Overall: **WAPE 12.75%**, MAE 62.30, RMSE 219.30.

## 1. Actual vs predicted
- Total predicted / total actual = **1.013** (balanced).
- In the group with the SMALLEST sales the average prediction is 2.71 x the actual; in the group with the LARGEST sales it is 0.99 x the actual (a value below 1 means the model under-predicts there).

## 2. Residual distribution
- Mean residual -6.52, median -1.41, standard deviation 219.20, skewness 8.9.
- Predicted too little on 35% of the rows, too much on 65%, exactly right on 0%.
- A long tail on one side means a few large errors dominate the squared error (RMSE).

## 3. Residuals over time
- Best day WAPE 10.6% (2017-07-01), worst day 15.8% (2017-07-13).
- Average daily bias -1.4%. The bias changes sign from day to day: no systematic drift.

## 4. Error by store
- The 5 stores with the largest share of the error: store 44 (3.4%, WAPE 8%), store 45 (3.3%, WAPE 8%), store 49 (3.3%, WAPE 10%), store 47 (3.2%, WAPE 9%), store 40 (3.1%, WAPE 21%).
- Among the bigger stores the worst WAPE is store 40 (20.6%), the best store 44 (8.0%).

## 5. Error by product family
- The 5 families with the largest share of the error: BEVERAGES (24.1%, WAPE 13%), GROCERY I (22.2%, WAPE 10%), CLEANING (12.1%, WAPE 18%), PRODUCE (9.7%, WAPE 8%), DAIRY (4.9%, WAPE 11%).
- Among the bigger families the hardest is HOME AND KITCHEN I (WAPE 45.1%), the easiest PRODUCE (8.4%).

## 6. Holidays vs normal days

| group | rows | days | WAPE % | bias % | share of the error % |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| normal days (no holiday, no event) | 52,767 | 30 | 12.7 | -1.3 | 98.5 |
| holidays (any scope) | 693 | 4 | 19.9 | -7.3 | 1.5 |
| local holidays | 693 | 4 | 19.9 | -7.3 | 1.5 |
| paydays (15th, month end) | 1,782 | 1 | 13.6 | -5.5 | 4.0 |
| weekends | 17,820 | 10 | 12.8 | -2.0 | 41.5 |
| weekdays | 35,640 | 20 | 12.7 | -0.8 | 58.5 |


## 7. Feature importance and SHAP
- Built-in importance, top 10: `sales_roll_28_mean` (0.190), `sales_roll_7_mean` (0.178), `sales_lag_21` (0.177), `sales_lag_28` (0.167), `store_family_mean_sales` (0.080), `sales_lag_16` (0.074), `promo_roll_7_mean` (0.026), `onpromotion` (0.016), `family_enc` (0.012), `promo_lag_7` (0.010).
